scenes.headline: How to read a profiler trace and find the bottleneck
scenes.sub: One matmul plus add on an A100, at two matrix sizes.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marten! A slow GPU is either doing too much work, or waiting on the CPU. Here's how the PyTorch profiler tells you which.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: The CPU launches kernels and the GPU runs them later. Compare each side's own time, and the trace names your bottleneck.

items.text: Wrap your code in a named region
items.say: Wrap your code in a named region, so you can find it among thousands of ops.
Record both CPU dispatch and CUDA kernels. The point is comparing them.
Schedule it: skip a step, run a warmup to throw away the cold start, and record three.

steps.say: The CPU walks your code and launches each kernel. The launch returns almost immediately: the kernel is queued, not run.
The GPU picks it up a moment later on its own stream, so the two lanes are staggered, not stacked.
At the end, the CPU blocks in device synchronize, waiting for the GPU to finish.

steps.note: 64x64: 23 us of kernels, GPU idle about 98%
steps.say: At sixty-four by sixty-four, the GPU lane is nearly empty: twenty-three microseconds of kernels in a wall milliseconds wide. It's idle roughly ninety-eight percent of the time.

left.title: 64 x 64
items: Self CPU 2.314 ms, Self CUDA 23.104 us
Fix: fewer launches, fused ops, torch.compile
left.say: At sixty-four, CPU time is a hundred times GPU time. That's overhead-bound: fuse or batch your launches.

right.title: 4096 x 4096
items: Self CPU 4.908 ms, Self CUDA 4.495 ms
Fix: optimize the gemm kernel itself
right.say: At four thousand ninety-six, GPU time rivals CPU time, and one matrix-multiply kernel is ninety-five percent of it. That's compute-bound: optimize the kernel.

scenes.text: You can't tell the regime from the code: the same three lines are overhead-bound or compute-bound by matrix size alone.

recap: Self CUDA much smaller than Self CPU: overhead-bound
Fuse launches for one, optimize kernels for the other
scenes.say: To recap: compare the two self times, then fix the regime you actually have.
